proves.claim: nextStepFor returns the step a submit-path refusal message spells out (push, fetch, claim, start, submit again) instead of the service-owner fallback.

cli.logic-step-words.submit-path-steps-n.why: Without it those refusals tell the person to ask the service owner while the message already names the step.

proves.claim: a clause starting with an existing repair word is still taken as the step, and a message with no step still falls to its NEXT_STEPS row.

cli.logic-step-words.existing-steps-unch.why: Without it widening the step verbs could silently change refusals that already worked.
